metadata.signature: DataFrame.groupby(by=None, level=None, *, as_index=True, sort=True, group_keys=True, observed=True, dropna=True)

self.description: Non-empty DataFrame with a string 'key' column suitable as a groupby key and a numeric 'val' column
self.constraints: st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=8).flatmap(lambda n: st.fixed_dictionaries({'key': st.lists(st.sampled_from(['a', 'b', 'c']), min_size=n, max_size=n), 'val': st.lists(st.integers(), min_size=n, max_size=n)}).map(pd.DataFrame))

self.description: DataFrame with a named two-level MultiIndex, for level-based groupby
DataFrame where the 'key' groupby column contains at least one NA value
self.constraints: st.integers(min_value=3, max_value=8).flatmap(lambda n: st.fixed_dictionaries({'key': st.lists(st.one_of(st.just(None), st.sampled_from(['a', 'b'])), min_size=n, max_size=n), 'val': st.lists(st.integers(), min_size=n, max_size=n)}).filter(lambda d: any(k is None for k in d['key'])).map(pd.DataFrame))

self.description: DataFrame with a categorical 'key' column where not all categories are observed (categories=['a','b','c'] but only 'a','b' appear)
self.constraints: st.integers(min_value=2, max_value=6).flatmap(lambda n: st.lists(st.sampled_from(['a', 'b']), min_size=n, max_size=n).map(lambda vals: pd.DataFrame({'key': pd.Categorical(vals, categories=['a', 'b', 'c']), 'val': list(range(len(vals)))})))

by.description: A label or list of labels may be passed to group by the columns in self
A list of labels to group by multiple columns in self
by=None; must be used together with level when grouping by MultiIndex level
If by is a function, it's called on each value of the object's index

level.description: Default; level is not used when by is specified
Group by a particular integer level of a MultiIndex; do not specify both by and level
Group by a named level of a MultiIndex; do not specify both by and level

as_index.description: Return object with group labels as the index. Only relevant for DataFrame input.

sort.description: If False, the groups will appear in the same order as they did in the original DataFrame

group_keys.description: When calling apply and by produces a like-indexed result, add group keys to index to identify pieces (default)
Do not add group keys to index when calling apply

observed.description: Only show observed values for categorical groupers (default since 3.0.0)
Show all values for categorical groupers

dropna.description: NA values together with row/column will be dropped (default)
NA values will also be treated as the key in groups

post_condition.source: Returns a groupby object that contains information about the groups.
Return object with group labels as the index. Only relevant for DataFrame input.
